measurement.rss: process.memoryUsage().rss; per process, never exclusive application footprint
measurement.privateMemory: process.getProcessMemoryInfo().private, KiB converted to bytes; pre-compression private memory, not physical footprint
measurement.privateBytes: Electron ProcessMetric privateBytes, Windows only; null on macOS
measurement.footprint: N/A unless independently measured with Instruments/VM Tracker
measurement.gpu: GPU process working set only; IOSurface allocation N/A
measurement.cold: Fresh application/profile/SQLite connection; OS filesystem cache is not flushed
measurement.cpu: CPU microseconds and Electron interval averages, reported separately from latency

limitations: Fresh isolated profiles/launches; OS filesystem cache remains warm.
Renderer DOM and JS heap are CDP point-in-time samples after history readiness; neither peak heap nor a leak verdict. Fixture events are user messages, not streaming model output.
Native close-to-hide and second-instance reopen exercise production host forwarding; each idle checkpoint confirms the Renderer received hidden=true.
Summed working sets include shared pages; not application exclusive footprint.
CPU interval averages share app.getAppMetrics sampling intervals with diagnostics.
PDF/OCR, background-busy and long idle are separate explicitly selected workloads; this startup report does not establish them.

baselineContext.description: Final P0 engineering baseline. Production source matched the application SHA; tracked modifications were the measured benchmark and audit/documentation changes. No concurrent Electron test or build was running.
